title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a package-less write onto a packaged view, dashboard, report, translation or email template is refused, naming the .custom pair (ADR-0146 D11)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XGGegFwyVNsGnkjggg3vi2i)_

Fixes #28576
Part of #28644 (item 1 only: the rollback of the pair's own declared row)

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`'s ADR-0146 paragraph said "a package-unbound Setup row still wins over the base's until D11"; it now says a pre-D11 row wins until migrated and D11 refuses new ones.

## 维护者速读

- 关闭无包写入：对已安装只读包发布的 view/dashboard/report/translation/email_template，不带 `?package=` 的保存、发布、删除（生效态）和回滚一律 `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`，消息点名 `<base>.custom` 与 `os migrate packageless-overlays`。
- 仍然开放：`?package=<base>.custom` 的读写；无包发布的名字（环境元数据）；草稿丢弃；包 id 无法派生配对包的基础包（迁移仪式列为 `no_pair`、无法搬迁，故不关）。
- 未迁移的无包行照常被所有读取服务，只是它的无包写入被拒；#28413 第 4 项的过渡放行（无包保存落到配对行时保留 `overrides`）随之删除。
- 回滚配对包自己声明的行按配对覆盖判定（`runtime-only` + 覆盖写门），不再按工件覆盖（#28644 第 1 项）。
- 控制台：Studio 只读标记不再链接 Setup 覆盖页；Setup 原样显示服务端拒绝（拒绝文字已压到 REST 门 500 字上限内）。
- 发布为 `minor` + **BREAKING**（发布窗口期门禁拒绝 major），ADR-0087 登记 `packageless-overlay-write-closed`；发布说明要求升级**前**先运行迁移仪式。

## What changes

- **The close** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`, `packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal`, asked through a host wrapper in `protocol.ts`). A write naming no package (`packageId` absent, `null` or empty) onto an item of the five overlay types that a read-only code package ships is refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, the code the sealed write already answers. It reads the registry only, so the ADR-0010 lock gate is still the first store reader (#5706 pins green). Asked by:
  - `saveMetaItem`, for authoring saves (`source` unset, not the package-duplicate face), ahead of the override write gate, so a body carrying `overrides` gets the same sentence;
  - `publishMetaItem`, right after the name grammar check;
  - `deleteMetaItem`, for the active item (`state !== 'draft'`);
  - `rollbackMetaItem`, on the restored row's own binding (`rollbackPackageId`).
- **"Packaged" is the ceremony's reading** (`overlayBaseShippers` → `readOnlyShippingPackages` in `protocol-environment-rows.ts`, now also used by `os migrate packageless-overlays`): `shippedArtifactsOf` less writable packages. A name no read-only package ships is environment metadata and keeps its package-less write. A name whose only shippers have ids no pair can be formed from (the ceremony's `no_pair`) is not closed either, because the ceremony cannot move that row.
- **The sentence**, fix first, under the REST door's 500-character cap (`CLIENT_MESSAGE_MAX`, `@objectstack/types`), which Setup shows as sent. For a save: `'view/showcase_task.in_progress' ships in 'com.example.showcase': save it into 'com.example.showcase.custom' (?package=com.example.showcase.custom), declaring overrides: { package: 'com.example.showcase', basedOn }. A write naming no package onto a packaged item is closed (ADR-0146 D11); a package-less customization stored before it is still served until `os migrate packageless-overlays` moves it into 'com.example.showcase.custom'.` Delete, publish and rollback have their own fix clause; a name several packages ship names each candidate pair.
- **Ruling 4** (`rollbackMetaItem`). When the restored row is the `.custom` pair's own row of an item its base ships (`isCustomizationPairOf`), the write intent is `runtime-only` and the restored body is judged by the override write gate (`overrideWriteVerdict`), so a declared override rolls back as the pair's override and an undeclared one is refused as on save.
- **Retired with the write**: #28413 item 4's allowance (`packagelessPairLanding`, `isPackagelessAuthoringSave` and the late "keeps that row's overrides" graft), together with its pins.
- **Console** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`). `StudioReadOnlyLink` is always the plain "Read-only" mark; it no longer links an `allowEnvironmentOverlay` item to its Setup page. Setup's save and reset already surface a 403's message verbatim; a new test pins that with the server's sentence.
- **Ledger and docs**: `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.packageless-overlay-write-closed.ts`, the changeset (FROM → TO, ceremony before upgrade), and the skills line.

## Tests

- **New / re-judged, each red on base and green on head** (production sources restored to the merge base, metadata-protocol dist rebuilt):
  - `packages/objectql/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.test.ts`, describe `[#28576] after the close`: package-less draft, publish-mode and `packageId: null` saves refused with and without `overrides`; package-less DELETE and publish refused; an unmigrated row served, its save, DELETE and rollback refused naming the ceremony, which then still moves it; ruling 4's pair rollback (a page). Controls, green on both: `?package=<pair>` save, publish and DELETE succeed; a name no package ships keeps its package-less save and delete.
  - `environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts` (10 red on base): each type's package-less save is refused naming the pair, and the same save into the pair is accepted and served.
  - `protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts` (2 red), `protocol.packaged-base-refusal.test.ts` (1), `protocol.package-door-before-gates.test.ts` (1): the code-package block and the two door pins now expect the close; the save-address case pins the sentence under 500 characters.
  - `environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts` (3 red): the administrator writes go into the pair (a probe showed the pair keeps one row per locale member, served across a restart and reset by member); the backfill and #23074 envelope cases seed package-less rows as an older release stored them, and their package-less save and reset are refused.
  - `protocol-packageless-read-dependent-package.test.ts` (1 red): the package-less save next to a dependent's row is refused naming the base's pair.
  - `StudioReadOnlyLink.overlay-27356.test.tsx` (1 red, the email template case): no item links anywhere.
- **Re-routed, not red-first**: `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-artifact-reload-registry-refresh.test.ts` saves its environment customization into the pair (its fixture gains `namespace: 'arl'`).
- **Dogfood, re-routed into the pair** (11 files, 26 cases red on the merged base's dogfood battery before the re-route). Every suite that customized a shipped view or email template with a package-less `PUT` / `DELETE` now ensures the base's pair and writes `?package=<base>.custom`, declaring the override, through a shared helper `packages/qa/dogfood/test/customization-pair.ts`: the four public-form withdrawal files, the public-form redirect, the walled-intake file, the email overlay, two-locales and materialization files, `meta-read-doors-live`, `managed-content-sealed` and `view-container-cross-package-default`. The last two also pin the package-less write's refusal naming the pair. The anonymous form doors serve the pair's override with no change. The two-locales file keeps its second locale (`zh-CN`, which the showcase does not ship) as a row stored before the close, and pins its package-less save and reset refused naming the ceremony; see the open question below.
- **Pin of existing behaviour, green on base**: `ResourceEditPage.packagelessWriteClosed-28576.test.tsx`, Setup's save and reset show the server's 403 sentence as sent.
- **`protocol.org-scoped-write-refused.test.ts`** is green and unchanged (its packages `pkg_a` / `pkg_b` form no pair).
- **Ablations**, one per refusal, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed fix, objectql legs with a rebuilt dist proved by `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`, each red as predicted and restored to the HEAD blob; a clean rebuild then answered `--absent` for every marker:
  - save → 4 red (save-address ×2, packaged-base-refusal, package-door-before-gates);
  - publish → the package-less publish case red;
  - delete → 4 red (the close describe ×2, the email reset ×2);
  - rollback → the unmigrated-row case red;
  - ruling 4 (`isCustomizationPairOf`) → the pair rollback case red;
  - the no-pair / no-shipper carve-out → 28 red in `protocol.org-scoped-write-refused.test.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Readings.**
  - Publish is closed too: a package-less publish of a packaged item's draft lands the same row a package-less save would.
  - Discarding a draft stays open (`state: 'draft'` deletes): it serves nothing, and `discardDraftInItsScope` passes the listed package, which may be null.
  - `packagelessAddress` keeps its body: for a shipped name every write door refuses before it resolves an address, and the reads still use it for unmigrated rows (Wanted 1's "stops answering" holds at the doors).
  - `packagedBaseRefusal` and the read envelope's `editable` / `deletable` keep their answers: they describe the item, which the pair's write still changes.
- **Deviation: `minor`, not `major`.** `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses a `major` during the launch window (a major on any package bumps the whole fixed group); breaking changes ship `minor` with **BREAKING**, which is what the changeset declares, with the ADR-0087 marker `registered packageless-overlay-write-closed`.
- **Fallout beyond the order's list.** The order expected two re-judged files; the measured reach was those plus `package-door-before-gates`, `packaged-base-refusal`, the email-locale file, the dependent-package file and the runtime reload test, all listed above. Aligning "packaged" with the ceremony's reading kept the lock-enumeration kit, the view-container suites and the org-scoped file green unchanged.
- **Skills line.** To stay under the bundle's token ceiling, the same paragraph drops "the base's is unchanged" after the export sentence, which "replaces the base's document whole" already implies.
- **Left in place.** The i18n key `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyLink` (en/zh in `@object-ui/i18n`) has no reader now; `ui/scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` (report-only) lists it as a candidate.
- **Open question: a sending locale the base does not ship.** Measured on a showcase boot (scratch probe, not committed): the pair's own `zh-CN` member of `showcase_task_done_email` saves (200) and reads by `?member=zh-CN`, but `getMetaItemsForExecution` leaves it out (the env-wide list narrows a name one code package ships at name grain), so a `zh-CN` send renders `en-US`. A `zh-CN` row stored package-less before the close is listed and sends, and `os migrate packageless-overlays` fails to move it (`failed`: the pair cannot declare an override of a locale the base does not ship, #28746 / #28777), so the row is kept. After this PR no door adds a new sending locale to a shipped template, and such a pre-close row can be neither written nor migrated; its refusal still says the ceremony moves it. This sits beside #28779's open question (what a base's address serves for a member it does not ship) and is left for that ruling.
- **Out of scope, noted.** A save naming the read-only code package itself (`?package=<base>`) for an overlay type is still accepted and lands an overlay bound to the base (`protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts`, code-package block, second case seeds one). It names a package, so it is not this card's write; it reads against ADR-0146 D1.

## Verification

- Live probe on a stock showcase boot (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase dev -- --fresh -p <port>`, signed in as the seeded admin), view `showcase_task.in_progress`:

  | Step | Base (`56fdd563`) | Head (`d5f9db8f`) |
  |---|---|---|
  | `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.in_progress` (no package) | 200, "Saved customization overlay (env-wide, state=active)" | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, the sentence above |
  | `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` | 201 | 201 |
  | `PUT …?package=com.example.showcase.custom` with `overrides: { package: 'com.example.showcase', basedOn: '0.1.0' }` | 200 | 200, served back |
  | `DELETE /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.in_progress` (no package) | 200 | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` |
  | `DELETE …?package=com.example.showcase.custom` | 200, nothing bound (the package-less row remained) | 200, reset to the package original |

- **Final head `4f1e0a49`** (origin/main `1caf6722` merged, no conflicts), every run through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (shared box):
  - build: turbo, 68 of 68 tasks;
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: 296 files, 22074 tests passed;
  - `@objectstack/objectql`: 521 files, 10006 passed;
  - `@objectstack/rest`: 370 files, 7208 passed;
  - `@objectstack/runtime`: 512 files, 9237 passed;
  - `ui/` targeted: 8 files, 63 passed (the two files this PR touches, plus the Studio read-only, customize and two-holder suites); `ui/scripts`: 169 files, 4900 passed;
  - `@objectstack/dogfood` typecheck: exit 0; scoped eslint on every changed file: 0 errors.
- **Gates**: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 101; 101 run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciled 101 of 101, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- **Dogfood battery** (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, no shard), on `4f1e0a49`: 376 files passed, 4 failed (3111 tests passed, 4 failed). The 4 are the 18.0 upgrade-fixture files (`upgrade-18x-harness`, `identity-mail-read-gate`, `audit-key-material`, `audit-mail-bodies`), each on the fixture's `sys_activity` copy (`no such table: sys_activity__r20261019`, or a rewrite count short by the activity rows). `sys_activity` rotates 14 daily shards (`plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-activity.object.ts`), and `ensureRotation` drops a shard older than the window by `Date.now()`, so the fixture's 2026-10-19 shard expired when the clock reached 2026-11-02, midway through this work. The same four passed in this branch's previous full battery the day before. Nothing here touches audit, activity or rotation; it is a clock-dependent red that `main` carries too (reasoned from the code and the two runs, not run on `main`).
